quote: Indeed, the first author posed this very question to Woodin in the spring of 1983.
posed_by: W. Hugh Woodin (question posed to him by Arthur W. Apter)
note: Arthur W. Apter posed this question to Woodin in spring 1983, and Woodin subsequently worked on it. The question asks whether GCH below a strongly compact cardinal implies GCH everywhere. Found in Apter & Shelah's 'Menas' Result is Best Possible' (Transactions of the American Mathematical Society, 1997).
